file: 011 - In This World When You Hold Hands For The First Time You See The Relationship's End - 2.1M.mp4

voices.first_words: In this world, the first time you hold hands
voices.sounds_like: ElevenLabs crisp young-male storytime TTS (~193 Hz, same as 013), ~90% sure
voices.gender_age_impression: young adult male, late teens to early 20s
voices.pitch_or_speed_effect: other (sped up ~1.2x from 0:00.0 to 0:29.8, then slowed to ~1.0x from 0:29.9 to 0:32.7)
voices.delivery: urgent earnest narration turning cold and measured at 0:29.9
voices.timing_notes: Breathless ~1.2x pace from 0:00.0 to 0:29.8 (only a 0.2s dip at 0:05.8); reads 'You weren't holding my hand to comfort me, David' fast (0:27.8-0:29.8), then drops to ~1.0x normal speed at 0:29.9 on 'You were pinning my arms down so I couldn't reach the emergency bu—' before cutting mid-word at 0:32.7.

one_voice_plays_several_characters: yes — one male TTS voices both narration and Sarah's terrified reveal (0:27.8-0:32.7) with no female voice swap; only playback speed drops from ~1.2x to ~1.0x at 0:29.9.

music.description: dark melancholic synthwave loop with detuned pads, high synth lead, muted pulse
music.how_it_follows_the_story: Loops steadily from 0:00.0 to the 0:32.7 mid-word cut; its ambiguous minor synthwave tone reads as bittersweet romance during the hospital/sofa visions (0:13.5-0:21.2) and sinister thriller underscore on the restraint reveal (0:27.8-0:32.7).

sound_effects.sound: rising swell into bright magical vision flash chime (0:02.0-0:02.6)
flash whoosh and hollow soda-can impact
warm low transition thump and breezy whoosh
low rumble (0:12.4) into bright golden flash-forward shimmer whoosh (0:13.5)
sharp hand-yank slap and fast recoil whoosh

ambience: none except faint hospital monitor tone in first vision (0:14.3-0:18.0)
sync_with_picture: Vision flashes sync to bright shimmer whooshes (0:02.3, 0:04.5, 0:13.5, and snap-back at 0:21.3); dark thud hits horrified Sarah (0:22.4); sharp slap-whoosh matches her arm yank (0:23.7); 0:30.0 dark thump reveals reframed hospital shot with old David's evil grin; 0:31.1 whip-pan whoosh hits the red wall button.
faces_and_mouths: 2D decals swap per beat (no phoneme lip-sync): old David wears a teary sad decal in the first hospital vision (0:13.5) and warm grin on the sofa (0:19.1), swapping to a hyper-detailed sinister grin in the reframed hospital flashback (0:30.0); Sarah shifts from blush (0:08.1) to shock (0:22.4), terror (0:26.8), and simple open/closed mouth frames (0:27.8).
comedic_or_emotional_timing: Breathless TTS + warm shimmer chimes (0:13.5, 0:19.3) sell a wholesome 'grow old together' fake-out until 0:21.2; then the 0:22.4 dark thud, 0:23.7 hand-yank slap, and sudden vocal slowdown to ~1.0x at 0:29.9 pull the thriller rug out.
first_3_seconds: Crisp pop at 0:00.1, urgent ~1.2x male TTS ('In this world, the first time you hold hands with someone, you instantly see—'), 0:00.6 whoosh on clasping hands, and 0:02.3 magical flash-chime over dark synthwave.
ending: Hard-cuts mid-word at 0:32.7 on 'emergency bu—' while caption shows 'the EMERGENCY button' and synthwave stays hot (-20.8 dB into -25.9 dB at 0:00.0), forcing mental completion across the loop seam.
mix: Vocal-centric storytime mix (-13.7 LUFS, tight LRA 1.9 LU, -0.1 dBTP) with 84.1% energy in 250 Hz-4 kHz and restrained sub-bass (3.7% <80 Hz; impacts at 90-130 Hz) for effortless mobile clarity.
why_the_sound_works: Recurring shimmer-whooshes (0:02.3, 0:13.5, 0:21.3) create instant audio grammar for flash-forwards.
Minor-key synthwave supports both the fake wholesome vision (0:13.5) and the thriller twist (0:27.8).
Dropping TTS speed from ~1.2x to ~1.0x at 0:29.9 chills the delivery right as old David's evil grin appears.
Chopping 'button' mid-word ('emergency bu—' at 0:32.7) triggers an involuntary replay.
unsure_about: Artist/title of the 92 BPM dark synthwave loop (left null; distinct from 006/013).
